set.autoColumnsDesc: In a logic chart the hierarchy runs vertically, so a large map turns into a tall thin strip and the horizontal space goes unused. When enabled, top-level branches are spread into several columns once a single column gets too tall.
set.autoFitDesc: Zoom to fill the viewport right after rendering
set.branchColorDesc: Each top-level branch gets its own color; children inherit it
set.canvasHeightDesc: With Auto this is the minimum height (small maps keep at least this much); with Fixed it is the exact height. Ignored by Fill viewport.
set.canvasHeightModeDesc: The height of an inline map decides both how much you can see and how far the page scrolls, so there are three ways to pick it: Auto grows with the node count, Fixed always stays the same, Fill viewport uses the whole editor viewport.
set.compactDesc: Tighter node spacing, better for maps with many nodes
set.compactThresholdDesc: Node spacing tightens automatically once the node count exceeds this value
set.ctrlWheelDesc: Hold Ctrl (⌘ on macOS) and scroll the mouse to zoom the mind map
set.customColorsDesc: Comma-separated hex colors, assigned to top-level branches in order and reused cyclically. Leave empty to use the theme palette.
set.dblclickEditDesc: Double-click a node to rename it; Enter commits, Esc cancels, and the change is written back to SiYuan
set.defaultLayoutDesc: The structure used when a mind map is opened from the block menu
set.diagDesc: Version / config / view states / recent warnings. Copied to the clipboard only — no network access, no reporting.
set.dragNodeDesc: Drag a node to change its order and level: drop on the top or bottom edge to make it a sibling, drop in the middle to make it a child
set.edgeStyleDesc: The shape of the connectors between nodes
set.flipAnimationDesc: Nodes slide to their new positions instead of jumping there
set.foldSyncDesc: Mind map folding is SiYuan's native list folding: collapse a node in the outline and the map follows, collapse it in the map and the outline follows. It is saved with the document, so the next time you open it the state is exactly as you left it.
set.hardLimitDesc: Rendering is paused with a notice once the node count exceeds this value, to keep the editor responsive
set.hoverPreviewDesc: Rest the mouse on a collapsed node and a card appears listing its first few children.
set.keyboardDesc: When the mind map has focus it takes over the keyboard (arrow keys to navigate, Tab to add a child, Enter to add a sibling, F2 to rename, and so on). Turn this off if it conflicts with SiYuan's shortcuts.
set.lazyRenderDesc: A list block is rendered only once it nears the viewport, so long documents scroll more smoothly
set.migrateDesc: Migrate mind maps marked by that plugin (custom-block-list-view = map) to Outline Mind Map
set.minimapAlwaysDesc: Also show the thumbnail on smaller maps. By default it only appears for larger maps (30+ nodes) — a small map already fits on screen, so the thumbnail would be redundant.
set.minimapDesc: Show a thumbnail in the bottom-right corner; click it to jump
set.shortcutHint: Click any node in the map to use the keyboard
set.showLevelDesc: Show 1.2.1-style level numbers for ordered lists
set.themeDesc: "Follow SiYuan" uses SiYuan's current colors; the others are built-in standalone palettes
set.viewPerDoc: Keep view preferences with the document
set.viewPerDocDesc: Layout / theme / edge changes made in this list are stored in block attributes (custom-mindmap-view) and restored the next time you open it; anything you have not changed keeps following the global defaults above.
set.wheelPanDesc: When on, the wheel pans the map directly; when off, it scrolls the page
shortcut.clip: Clipboard: Ctrl+C copy subtree · Ctrl+V paste as a child · Ctrl+X cut · Ctrl+D quick duplicate
shortcut.edit: Edit: Tab add child · Shift+Tab demote · Enter add sibling · F2 rename · Delete/Backspace delete · Alt+←/→ promote/demote · Ctrl+↑/↓ move up/down
shortcut.filter: Filter: the "All / To do / Done" control in the toolbar shows only one kind of task (this group collapses by itself when the map has no tasks)
shortcut.focus: Focus: Ctrl/⌘ + double-click a node (or "Focus this branch" in the context menu) shows only that branch; Esc walks back one level at a time
shortcut.global: {toggle} switch the list at the cursor between mind map / outline · {side} open the mind map in a side panel
shortcut.globalTitle: Global (these work anywhere in the document; change them under Settings → Keymap):
shortcut.mark: Marks: right-click a node → "Add mark" to attach an icon / label / custom color; stored in block attributes, so it travels with copied blocks, exports, and other devices
shortcut.multi: Multi-select: Shift + drag to box-select · Ctrl + click to add · Ctrl+A selects all siblings (press again for the whole tree); with 2 or more selected a batch bar appears (promote / demote / collapse / mark done / export / delete)
shortcut.nav: Navigate: ↑↓ siblings · ← parent · → first child · Home/End first/last · Space collapse
shortcut.present: Present: the ▶ in the toolbar enters presentation mode — → / Space / PageDown advance, ← / PageUp go back, Esc exits (never modifies the document)
shortcut.search: Search: Ctrl+F opens the search box; the "This map / Whole document" toggle switches the scope — whole document searches every mind map in this document, and clicking a result jumps straight to it
shortcut.todo: Tasks: X marks the selected task nodes done / not done (you can also click the checkbox on a node)
shortcut.view: View: Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- zoom · Ctrl+0 fit canvas · Ctrl+1 back to 100% · Ctrl+F search · F fullscreen · Esc exit

tip.searchScope: Switch search scope: this map / all mind maps in this document

toggleSidePanel: Open the mind map in the side panel
